description: Convert a scene's literal colours and widths into named roles it can be restyled by.
phrases: turn this figure's colours into roles
adopt a traced drawing into a style guide
replace literal styles with named roles
returns: the scene to --out, its literals replaced by roles; a count on stderr

examples.output: [polymerase] 1 element(s) -> 1 role(s): 0 matched the guide, 1 named adopted-NN
